answer: Bind each identity to a device fingerprint: the canvas, fonts, and hardware features of the agent's machine form a sable-dark signature that is hard to change without changing the machine. A raven among a thousand identical virtual machines stands out — they all share the same fingerprint, so the network groups them as one operator and caps their rewards. A reef of fake identities running on cloned images collapses into a single cluster, because each new identity needs a genuinely distinct device profile, and renting a thousand distinct machines costs far more than the rewards they could earn.
